Enigmatic Ectostella.enDesc: A fathomless crystal. Ascension material for the Trailblazer.

Lightning Crown of the Past Shadow.nameEn: Lightning Crown of the Past Shadow
Lightning Crown of the Past Shadow.enDesc: Headwear of the Guardian Shadows. Can be used for the Ascension of Lightning characters.

Horn of Snow.enDesc: Broken horn of a Frigid Prowler. Can be used for the Ascension of Ice characters.

Storm Eye.enDesc: Arrows belonged to a Stormbringer. Can be used for the Ascension of Wind characters.

Broken Teeth of Iron Wolf.enDesc: Fragmented saw teeth left behind by automatons. Can be used for the Ascension of Physical characters.

Void Cast Iron.enDesc: Horseshoe of a Voidranger: Trampler. Can be used for the Ascension of Quantum characters.

Golden Crown of the Past Shadow.nameEn: Golden Crown of the Past Shadow
Golden Crown of the Past Shadow.enDesc: Headwear of the Decaying Shadow. Can be used for the Ascension of Imaginary characters.

Endotherm Chitin.enDesc: Hot, translucent substance almost like fire in the solid state. Can be used for the Ascension of Fire characters.

Gelid Chitin.enDesc: Frosty chitin emitting a cold humming. Can be used for the Ascension of Ice characters.

Shape Shifter's Lightning Staff.enDesc: A wooden staff with a pointed tip. It belonged to a shape shifter from the Disciples of Sanctus Medicus. Can be used for the Ascension of Lightning characters.

Ascendant Debris.enDesc: Remains of The Ascended. Can be used for Ascension of Wind characters.

Suppressing Edict.enDesc: Parts used in the Xianzhou ingenium technology. Can be used for the Ascension of Imaginary characters.

Nail of the Ape.enDesc: Remnant of an Abundance Sprite. Can be used for the Ascension of Quantum characters.

Searing Steel Blade.enDesc: The broken blade of a Searing Prowler. Can be used for the Ascension of Fire-Type characters.

Netherworld Token.enDesc: The Aurumaton Spectral Envoy's weapon. Can be used for the Ascension of Physical characters.

Dream Fridge.enDesc: The fridge carried by Sweet Gorilla. Can be used for the Ascension of Ice characters.

Raging Heart.enDesc: The memoria core of "Shell of Faded Rage". Can be used for the Ascension of Fire characters.

IPC Work Permit.enDesc: An IPC "Senior Staff" work permit. Can be used for the ascension of Physical characters.

A Glass of the Besotted Era.nameEn: A Glass of the Besotted Era
A Glass of the Besotted Era.enDesc: A golden goblet of fine wine held by the troupe's cupbearer. Can be used for the Ascension of Wind characters. A group of believers treads across countless stars, seeking memories of numerous fine wines, brewing their offerings in dreams. Another group of believers turns themselves into yeast, fermenting ancient faiths sealed by the dust of time, distilling their ideals within dreams.

Nail of the Beast Coffin.enDesc: A section of a mech's bionic spinal column. Can be used for the Ascension of Lightning characters. The most important central component of the mech that was built in imitation of the borisin. Though the body that nurtured it no longer has even a sliver of life left, this component still maintains the "Slaughter Algorithm" inherited from primordial days and buried deep within its genes.

Dream Flamer.enDesc: A flamer that instantly cooks food. Can be used for the Ascension of Quantum characters.

Chordal Mirage.enDesc: The silver strings from the red instruments carried by the troupe's instrumentalists. Can be used for the Ascension of Imaginary characters.

Harbinger of Strife.enDesc: The golden wheeled blade carried by Furiae Praetor. Can be used for Ascension of Imaginary characters.

Darkveil Moonlight.enDesc: An alien crown left behind by the Moonlit Pegasus. Can be used for Ascension of Quantum characters.

Invasive Clot.enDesc: Black Tide Creatures' core crystal. Can be used for the Ascension of Physical characters.

Charred Bud of Twilight.enDesc: A corrosive core found within the head of a Dark Sun Gryphon. Can be used for Ascension of Wind characters.

Sea Siren's Torn Fin.enDesc: Lady of Crashing Waves's spiny tail fin. Can be used for the Ascension of Ice characters.

Radiant Prominence.enDesc: An alien crown left behind by the Noontide Gryphon. Can be used for Ascension of Fire characters.

Thunder Strum.enDesc: A favorite instrument of the Rocking Rebels. An ascension material for Lightning characters.
